codec_policy: Quantized targets must match the normalized quantization codec in supported_codecs. Unquantized targets may be covered by the none marker or by an allowlist containing every measured target tensor storage dtype.
hardware_policy: Targets require an explicit cpu/cuda/gpu class or detected GPU device name in supported_hardware; unresolved hardware fails closed.
calibration_policy: When minimum_support_coverage is declared, inference measures the fraction of non-missing numeric and known categorical feature groups per candidate and abstains below the signed threshold.
prediction_policy: For the binary safe_mutation target, inference uses predict_proba when available and otherwise accepts boolean predictions mapped to 0/1. It abstains on model inference exceptions or when a candidate prediction is malformed, outside the [0, 1] probability range, target-incompatible, or non-finite; physical evaluation remains authoritative.
lineage: adapted children retain immutable parent bundle and request identity
